# ATME College of Engineering

> ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru — an autonomous, AICTE-approved, VTU-affiliated, NAAC A+ accredited engineering institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across Civil, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical, and allied disciplines.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ATME College of Engineering, accreditations, and programmes.
- [About](/about): History, vision and mission, leadership.
- [Administration](/administration): Governing council and administrative team.
- [Admissions](/admissions): UG and PG admission information.
- [Departments](/departments): All academic departments and faculty.
- [Research](/research): Research activities, publications, and centres.
- [Placements](/placements): Recruiter list and placement statistics.
- [Campus Life](/campus-life): Student life, clubs, and events.
- [Campus Tour](/campus-tour): Virtual tour of the campus.
- [Careers](/careers): Career opportunities at ATME.
- [Library](/library): Library resources and services.
- [Resources](/resources): Notes, papers, videos, and e-library.
- [Sports](/sports): Sports facilities and achievements.
- [News Clippings](/news-clippings): Media coverage.
- [Upcoming Events](/upcoming-events): Conferences, workshops, and events.
- [Circulars](/circulars): Official circulars.
- [NIRF](/nirf): NIRF disclosures.
- [NABL](/nabl): NABL accreditation details.
- [Mandatory Disclosure](/mandatory-disclosure): AICTE mandatory disclosure.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, and email.
